author: melolontus
body:
If you or another user used an item called **"summoning scroll"** you get that as a result, that item summons a world Raid boss. If other player used the scroll, he selected the option of **public** instead of **private** for the  visibility of that Raid boss, that's why you can see it.

Try to hit him as many as possible and you will get a lot of exp and items when defeated by you or other player.

If the monster is near your wayvessel, members of your party can help you defeat the monster.
